## Page

Link the page and, if it helps, the section (for example `https://docs.lumi.nieve.ai/configuration/handoff#calendar-booking`).

## What were you trying to do?

Describe what you needed to achieve and how the page got in the way.

## What's wrong

Quote or describe the part that is wrong, out of date, unclear or broken.

## What happened instead

If you followed the page, describe what Lumi actually did and what you expected.

## Environment

- Lumi version or commit:
- Deployment method:
- Browser / operating system, if the site itself misbehaved:

## Evidence

Include sanitized logs or screenshots. Remove credentials, private conversations, and personal information. Report security vulnerabilities privately as SECURITY.md describes instead of using this template.
